newsitem.title: USA: Multimedia Games modifies MegaMania game.
newsitem.headline: Multimedia Games modifies MegaMania game.

text.p: Multimedia Games Inc said Wednesday it has modified its MegaMania video game to comply a request by the U.S. Justice Department that the company make it clear MegaMania is a bingo game.

MegaMania is an interactive multimedia bingo game that is delivered to players via video, sound, graphics and animation. Multimedia has contracts to supply more than 50 Indian nations with gaming products.

It was important that MegaMania qualify as a bingo game because, under the Indian Gaming Regulatory Act, American Indians are allowed to operate bingo games without special permission on reservations in states where bingo is legal, said Multimedia Chairman and Chief Executive Gordon Graves. He said bingo was legal in all but three or four states.
The Justice Department asked the company to modify MegaMania in February, Multimedia said.

Since then, the National Indian Gaming Commission has reviewed and inspected the modified system, the company said. It believes, after analysis of the changes, the commission will agree that all modifications have been designed to meet the requests made of the company and that MegaMania complies with the gaming act.
But the company said it was possible the commission's analysis will require a judicial review, which Multimedia expects will result in a favorable outcome.
